name: tt-pi-0.5
description: Port of the π0.5 vision-language-action robotics model to a single Blackhole p150a via TTNN. The default path runs the whole action-sampling call as three persistent generic-op megakernel programs on 110 cores (SigLIP vision, Gemma-2B prefix, and the flow-matching action expert), replayed from one Metal trace per prompt bucket, with earlier whole-model and op-by-op paths kept as comparators. Serves over HTTP and over openpi's websocket protocol, with LIBERO evaluation against GPU.
author: changh95
